requirements.description: Move OAuth token persistence and refresh handling into the API library, exposing updated token data to the integration through a callback.

label.evidence: homeassistant/components/cookidoo/coordinator.py — the diff removes _AuthDataHolder, persist_auth_data, and save_auth_data, as well as the integration's token-persistence logic.
label.notes: The reviewer recommends moving token persistence into the API layer. The author subsequently confirms that upstream version 0.18.4 implements an on_auth_data_update callback and that the integration's previous persistence code has been removed.
